TITLE: Locker Facility
INTRO_1: The bank provides locker facilities to customers for the safe keeping of valuables such as jewellery, documents, and other important items.
INTRO_2: Lockers are available in different sizes to suit customer requirements, subject to availability at the branch.
NOTE_1: Locker rent is payable annually in advance along with applicable GST.
NOTE_2: Allotment of lockers is subject to availability and bank rules.
